description: Change a link: its destination, title, tags or expiry, or turn it off or back on with isActive. People who tap the link afterwards get the change, so this needs confirm: true. Without it nothing changes: you get a preview of the current and proposed values to show the user first. null clears expiresAt / expiredAction / expiredUrl. isActive is sent on its own: false pauses the link (taps get the "link not found" page), true turns a paused link back on (taps follow within about 30 seconds). A link disabled for breaking the acceptable use policy cannot be turned back on, and if another active link now uses the slug, pause or rename that one first.

confirm.description: true to apply the change; omit or false to preview it

isActive.description: Alone: false pauses the link, true turns a paused link back on

slug.description: The link's slug: the part after the link domain, e.g. `summer` in https://hilltop.strait.link/summer

name: update_link
title: Update a link
